name: Tiffany Jung
description: Tiffany Jung is an independent arts professional with 10 years of experience in art operations, exhibitions, production, and international artwork logistics.
intro: I work where art meets the to-do list. With 10 years of experience across artist studios, galleries, auction houses, and international art fairs, I help artists, galleries, and creative teams bring projects together and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly. From exhibitions and production to client relationships and international artwork logistics, I take care of the details that keep things moving.
